name: Unleash MCP Server
description: Helps coding agents decide when a change needs a feature flag, then create, wrap, roll out, and clean up Unleash flags through a local npx or instance-hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Flag Need Evaluation
skills.description: Scores a code change for risk with evaluate_change and detects existing flags to avoid duplicates.

skills.name: Flag Creation And Wrapping
skills.description: Creates a typed, validated flag and generates language-specific code to wrap the change.

skills.name: Rollout Management
skills.description: Reads flag state, sets rollout strategies, and toggles flags per environment.

skills.name: Flag Cleanup
skills.description: Generates instructions for safely removing a flag from the codebase after rollout.
